when_used: A trustee in bankruptcy applies to be registered as trustee over the bankrupt proprietor's land, attaching the court order.

detail_rows.label: ID/Passport/Company Registration No. of the Trustee(if any)

body_text.text: The Applicant HEREBY APPLIES to be registered as Trustee in Bankruptcy in respect of the above noted land.
In support of this Application, the Applicant attaches a Certified True copy of the Court Order and supporting documents.

custom_fields.name: bankrupt_name
custom_fields.label: Name of the proprietor or bankrupt
custom_fields.prompt: Full name of the registered proprietor who has been adjudged bankrupt

custom_fields.name: date_of_court_order
custom_fields.label: Date of the court order
custom_fields.prompt: The date of the court order appointing the trustee in bankruptcy
